raw_text: A fitter was using an angle grinder to clear a blockage from a diesel generator fuel tank at the Baghjan site. A fragment of the ruptured tank struck the worker's right leg below the knee, resulting in a fracture that necessitated surgical intervention.

His right index finger was entrapped in the internal mechanism and severely damaged. The unit is currently recovering in hospital after undergoing surgical intervention, and the equipment was observed to be operating without the required safety guards in place.

His hand was inside the machine and his right index finger was caught and severely damaged in a mechanism in the panel. He was hospitalized and had surgery. The machine was unguarded at the time of the incident.

osha_nature_title: Cuts, lacerations, punctures without injury to internal structures
osha_narrative: An employee was cleaning in a confined space using the lance (hose) of a 20,000-psi water blasting pump when they lost control of the water lance. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
